title: Disposal of electric vehicle batteries
summary: As of April 2026, the County has deconstructed 30,000 pounds of electric vehicle batteries for disposal, according to the administrator. The agency is working to set up an end-of-life program for these batteries. The issue arose from loose electric vehicle batteries being left by the road.
